g.title: MarieRank5Convo1 begins.
g.text: MarieRank5Convo1 begins.

g.title: j3600787438
g.text: May we speak ?

g.title: j709500590
g.text: Evaluate expressions

g.title: j2560399282
g.text: I have been thinking over what you said about le Cardinal. That his actions are... a "mix" of benign and foul.

g.title: j709500590->j2560399282
g.text: MarieEntrati4a

g.title: j1193997864
g.text: I have been thinking over your words about le Cardinal. That his actions have brought pain to Lyon.

g.title: j709500590->j1193997864
g.text: MarieEntrati4b

g.title: j3415888806
g.text: I have been thinking more on our conversation regarding M'sieur Tagfer, and your convincing arguments for why he despises le Cardinal so.

g.title: j709500590->j3415888806
g.text: MarieEntrati3a

g.title: j3032308247
g.text: I have been thinking more on my argument with M'sieur Tagfer, and his reasons for despising le Cardinal so.

g.title: j709500590->j3032308247
g.text: MarieEntrati3b

g.title: j3650350541
g.text: I have been thinking more on my argument with M'sieur Tagfer. And our argument about that argument.

g.title: j709500590->j3650350541
g.text: MarieEntrati3

g.title: j3472855037
g.text: I feel a great much has been left unsaid regarding le Cardinal. The others seem to walk on eggshells around me, afraid to speak of him.

g.title: j709500590->j3472855037
g.text: false

g.title: j3014736862
g.text: I know others wish to paint him a cur, a madman, a traitor. But he was not those things to me.

g.title: j2718976672
g.text: Check boolean MarieBackstory1

g.title: j1931450226
g.text: Perhaps it is because I am so accustomed to being abandoned.

g.title: j2718976672->j1931450226
g.text: true

g.title: j3760926098
g.text: I was abandoned by my family, left on the streets when I was a child, due to being... abnormal. Broken. Unfit for high society.

g.title: j2718976672->j3760926098
g.text: false

g.title: j2425369306
g.text: Perhaps it is because I never had a father to speak of, that I am so willing to forgive him for his absence.

g.title: j4106479212
g.text: Evaluate expressions

g.title: j968364583
g.text: But the fact remains that I do forgive him. For I see more value in his good deeds than harm in his foul ones.

g.title: j4106479212->j968364583
g.text: MarieEntrati4a

g.title: j1224158289
g.text: I pray that Lyon is strong and survives the crisis of faith he suffers, but I do not believe it to be entirely a fault of le Cardinal's making.

g.title: j4106479212->j1224158289
g.text: MarieEntrati4b

g.title: j2985088239
g.text: So while I appreciate your convincing arguments regarding M'sieur Tagfer and those who have been harmed by him... I still see more value in his good deeds than harm in his foul ones.

g.title: j4106479212->j2985088239
g.text: MarieEntrati3a

g.title: j2889393224
g.text: So while I appreciate M'sieur Tagfer's ire, and can sympathize with his points, he must find the space in his own heart to forgive le Cardinal. For I see more value in le Cardinal's good deeds than harm in his foul ones.

g.title: j4106479212->j2889393224
g.text: MarieEntrati3b

g.title: j60132394
g.text: So while I appreciate everyone's histories with le Cardinal, especially M'Sieur Tagfer, I still see more value in his good deeds than harm in his foul ones.

g.title: j4106479212->j60132394
g.text: MarieEntrati3

g.title: j1792975772
g.text: So while I appreciate everyone's histories with le Cardinal, I still see more value in his good deeds than harm in his foul ones.

g.title: j4106479212->j1792975772
g.text: false

g.title: j2039433942
g.text: I don't fault you for appreciating the good he's done in your life, the same way I don't fault other people for resenting the harm he's causing in theirs.

g.title: j3560548713
g.text: I don't know. I think his actions have led to a lot more harm than good. I wish you could see that.

g.title: j1688276009
g.text: I'm siding with you, Marie. I can't fault Entrati for any of what he's done. He's fighting the Indifference.

g.title: j4254541553
g.text: You're right to forgive Entrati. I wish more of the others would follow your lead.

g.title: j3225400760
g.text: I'll never fault someone for forgiveness. But you can forgive someone while understanding you have to protect yourself and others from them.

g.title: j3428741264
g.text: You think Lyon's suffering is his own fault?

g.title: j1279348108
g.text: Lyon is suffering far more than a crisis of faith, Marie. And a lot of that has to do with Entrati.

g.title: j1755455395
g.text: Did nothing I said even slightly work to even the scales?

g.title: j379386513
g.text: How can you look at everything Entrati has done and still see more good than harm?

g.title: j2503243659
g.text: I think you're downplaying the seriousness of what the Cavia and Tagfer suffered.

g.title: j2794136629
g.text: Forgiveness is important. But so is acknowledging that Entrati might be more complicated than you're willing to accept.

g.title: j3318175265
g.text: I still don't think you understand what Tagfer and the Cavia suffered. It's worse than what you went through.

g.title: j1506979406
g.text: But do you see how the two are not of equal value ? Resentment and veneration ? I wish for the others to give up their malicious grudges.

g.title: j4288371264
g.text: Evaluate expressions

g.title: j3142094137
g.text: Evaluate expressions

g.title: j2325622337
g.text: And is that what you suggest we do ? Outcast le Cardinal ? I would argue that seems to be what he has done to himself, non ?

g.title: j2739885369
g.text: I think Lyon suffers from many ailments, much of which owing to doubt in himself and his own mind. Le Cardinal seems to have... only quickened matters.

g.title: j2506713978
g.text: What would you have me do ? Burn an effigy of le Cardinal and denounce him ? Condemn him to the Void, wish him harm like M'sieur Tagfer ?

g.title: j3937526700
g.text: That's the issue, Marie. What you're asking of other people. Not what they're asking of you. Or of Entrati.

g.title: j134937786
g.text: Entrati leaves hurt people wherever he goes. All I'm trying to do is help those people put everything back together. I don't care much about "good" or "evil" in his case.

g.title: j2932057706
g.text: Oui, and you are so consistent in your hatred for him ! Has nothing I have said done to soften you toward le Cardinal in turn ?

g.title: j4288371264->j2932057706
g.text: MarieEntratiMonster1

g.title: j4288371264->j2932057706
g.text: MarieEntratiMonster2

g.title: j755804628
g.text: Were you not speaking to me of how you favored Entrati, same as I, not but moments ago ? What has now changed your mind ?

g.title: j4288371264->j755804628
g.text: MarieEntratiFan1

g.title: j4288371264->j755804628
g.text: MarieEntratiFan2

g.title: j1194590355
g.text: Oui, and you seem to think Entrati such a monstre ! You are so quick to dismiss his kindness in turn !

g.title: j4288371264->j1194590355
g.text: false

g.title: j981006002
g.text: Were you not speaking to me of Entrati's monstruosité just moments prior ? What has now changed your mind ?

g.title: j3142094137->j981006002
g.text: MarieEntratiMonster1

g.title: j3142094137->j981006002
g.text: MarieEntratiMonster2

g.title: j282361841
g.text: Merci, and you have been my stalwart companion on this crusade ! I fear that we are alone in such regard - even Monsieur Loid harbors such resentment...

g.title: j3142094137->j282361841
g.text: MarieEntratiFan1

g.title: j3142094137->j282361841
g.text: MarieEntratiFan2

g.title: j362718714
g.text: Merci, and how glad I am to hear it ! I fear that we are alone in such regard - even Monsieur Loid harbors such resentment...

g.title: j3142094137->j362718714
g.text: false

g.title: j4201352038
g.text: I think the issue is more what you're asking of others, not what they're asking of you. Or Entrati.

g.title: j2554379994
g.text: And it doesn't bother you?

g.title: j3892294558
g.text: And what is it that I am asking of others that is so grotesque ? To accept forgiveness into their hearts ?

g.title: j2224225171
g.text: Noble, if tiresome, to travel through time and space, aiding his mécontents, non ? Surely you must resent him for this...

g.title: j1346084680
g.text: This conversation was a mistake...

g.title: j3206731386
g.text: I honestly have been struggling to navigate this topic with you. Painfully so. I personally think he's... neither good nor bad. But a mix.

g.title: j2313314925
g.text: I've changed my mind. I'm on his side. And yours. You convinced me.

g.title: j1167307417
g.text: [Confess feelings.] I've just been trying to do my best to... get on your good side, I'm afraid. I have feelings for you. More than I let on.

g.title: j1547477134
g.text: I've changed my mind and decided he's a monster. Once and for all.

g.title: j3517259439
g.text: Together, perhaps we can stand guard against those who would besmirch his good deeds, oui ? But I wonder, against all that surrounds you... why take my side ?

g.title: j2159116448
g.text: Check boolean LyonDating

g.title: j2669624490
g.text: You've put Entrati on a pedestal, Marie. And you're asking others to do the same thing like idiots.

g.title: j3807987740
g.text: I think you're asking them to do more than to just forgive Entrati. I think you're asking them to pretend nothing he did was ever wrong at all.

g.title: j3623460974
g.text: Sure. But I also have him to "thank" for some of the most important relationships and friendships I've ever made.

g.title: j2158471681
g.text: No, not really. He needs me to do it, so I'll do it. I'll judge him when all is said and done.

g.title: j2951875579
g.text: Wait, Marie. Please. Let me explain.

g.title: j3468863412
g.text: I've made it clear how I feel about Entrati. I'm sorry. On some things, we can't see eye-to-eye.

g.title: j670931099
g.text: Boolean MarieEntratiMonster1 is now false.

g.title: j1377988471
g.text: Boolean MarieEntratiMonster1 is now false.

g.title: j1120832342
g.text: Boolean DrifterMarieWhoops is now true.

g.title: j2760909480
g.text: Boolean MarieEntratiFan1 is now false.

g.title: j3256638996
g.text: Not that I am complaining, mind !

g.title: j830748262
g.text: I know he has found a place inside your heart, and for this I am so truly grateful - perhaps I can finally stop worrying about him, and all this fighting will soon be moot -

g.title: j2159116448->j830748262
g.text: true

g.title: j1621414413
g.text: But of course it bothers me. He is the brother of my soul ! My Lyon is the dearest thing in this world to me, and to see him in pain brings an ache in my chest as if his agonie is my own.

g.title: j2159116448->j1621414413
g.text: false

g.title: j839847494
g.text: Watch your words, Drifter.

g.title: j4009221558
g.text: Je ne suis pas naïve, do not speak to me as if I am such !

g.title: j4181489293
g.text: Perhaps he is only lancing a poison so that the body can heal, and this is all merely a necessary cruelty.

g.title: j3443320110
g.text: [Confess feelings.] I care about you. More than I've let on. And I... I'm sorry I've been harsh, but I can't let him hurt you. Not like he's hurt so many others.

g.title: j3805268008
g.text: I have watched Entrati do nothing but burn everyone he cares about. Everyone he has supposedly loved. I don't want to see him do the same to you...

g.title: j3711624884
g.text: I'm not the best at expressing myself, and for that I'm sorry. But he's... I'm afraid he's using you, and using your kindness to manipulate you. That's all.

g.title: j1648061871
g.text: You may see Entrati as a savior, but I see him as an old, frightened man scrambling for answers. Maybe the answer is somewhere in between.

g.title: j323994022
g.text: Oui. It seems so.

g.title: j3925953987
g.text: Boolean MarieEntratiMonster2 is now false.

g.title: j2860257755
g.text: Boolean MarieEntratiMonster2 is now false.

g.title: j748561079
g.text: And you have decided to deceive me to get into my good graces... je vois.

g.title: j1837066232
g.text: Boolean MarieEntratiFan2 is now false.

g.title: j2805287818
g.text: [Confess feelings.] I care about you. More than I've let on.

g.title: j3695458206
g.text: I believe anything is necessary in this war. We're trying to save the universe against the Indifference, after all, aren't we?

g.title: j4179269970
g.text: I believe in Entrati. Honestly. I think he has a plan to solve this, and all this has been for the ultimate good.

g.title: j3784890332
g.text: But his fall from faith is not the doing of le Cardinal. The crack in the foundations were there. More pressure was simply added, oui ?

g.title: j4058150249
g.text: Boolean MarieWarning is now true.

g.title: j257754078
g.text: I am well aware le Cardinal is both Lua and Sol - light and dark - good and evil. He is neither, and both, and capable of kindness and cruelty.

g.title: j1384331669
g.text: This is why the others get upset when you talk about him. You gloss over everything he's done that's hurt them and pretend it hasn't happened like idiots.

g.title: j38197827
g.text: Marie, stop. You need to accept that he's not doing this all purely because he's a good man. He's not. He's more complicated than that.

g.title: j2676584549
g.text: Boolean DrifterMarie is now true.

g.title: j3016332739
g.text: Watch your words, Drifter.

g.title: j3703905176
g.text: I do not need to be protected like I am ! Je ne suis pas une enfant naïve !

g.title: j3051126039
g.text: Boolean MarieEntrati5g is now true.

g.title: j3565911761
g.text: Boolean MarieEntratiFan1 is now false.

g.title: j3526847328
g.text: Boolean MarieEntratiFan2 is now true.

g.title: j128450754
g.text: Well, when you say it like that...

g.title: j1581049149
g.text: Only partially.

g.title: j4011513176
g.text: Boolean MarieEntratiMonster2 is now true.

g.title: j3544426853
g.text: Boolean DrifterMarieWhoops is now true.

g.title: j1035308381
g.text: Oui ! Precisely ! Finally, someone who sees sense. It breaks my heart that innocents must be harmed in this war, but all is at stake.

g.title: j1889145551
g.text: Boolean MarieWillDate is now true.

g.title: j678198188
g.text: Marie, he isn't a god. He's just a man. He's just as arrogant and just as dangerous as Roathe. He comes from the same society and suffers all the same problems.

g.title: j3685690691
g.text: I know he was kind to you. I know he was different to you maybe than he has been to a lot of people. Maybe he even treated you like a daughter... But look at the bigger picture, please.

g.title: j3481236328
g.text: I - I do not know how to handle this news, given... given our current conversation. I am taken... quite aback by this.

g.title: j2668370327
g.text: Boolean MarieWarning is now true.

g.title: j1429641559
g.text: I am well aware le Cardinal is both Lua and Sol - light and dark - good and evil. He is neither, and both, and capable of kindness and cruelty.

g.title: Chat ends. Next chat will be MarieEntratiDay2.
g.text: Chat ends. Next chat will be MarieEntratiDay2.

g.title: j3051126039->Chat ends. Next chat will be MarieEntratiDay2.
j2281633512
g.text: Boolean MarieEntratiFan2 is now false.

g.title: j105625626
g.text: Oui ? I am... hopeful, but unconvinced. Choose your words more carefully, Drifter...

g.title: j1073700449
g.text: Boolean MarieNoDate is now true.

g.title: j27501041
g.text: Oui ? Do you think me a child, or a fool ? Choose your words more carefully, Drifter...

g.title: j1254319071
g.text: And you have taken le Cardinal's side in order to get in my good graces... je vois.

g.title: j685143775
g.text: And in war, innocent lives are spent. This is sad, but it is fact, non ?

g.title: j411306976
g.text: Boolean MarieFamilyFail is now true.

g.title: j186114698
g.text: He is a man who summoned - or perhaps even created - a god ! And now is the only one who stands between it and the destruction of our universe !

g.title: j776166173
g.text: You think I do not know that I was not the only "daughter" he abandoned ?! I am merely the only one who forgives !

g.title: j1913976806
g.text: Do you truly mean to do this now ?! Like this ?! Here ?! Vraiment ?!

g.title: j3040052195
g.text: Oui ? I will...forgive you this lie, but consider yourself warned. Choose your words more carefully, Drifter...

g.title: j1390546219
g.text: Boolean MarieWarning is now true.

g.title: j4094969604
g.text: Boolean MarieEntrati5i is now true.

g.title: j2353018876
g.text: Boolean MarieWarning is now true.

g.title: j3611422301
g.text: Well, when you say it like that...

g.title: j3069140808
g.text: Only partially. I do honestly believe in Entrati.

g.title: j2403432175
g.text: Exactly. Roathe would be so proud of you.

g.title: j232861636
g.text: How many holy wars have been committed in Sol's name? What's one more, right?

g.title: j1826678430
g.text: Add -10 to Family counter

g.title: j2163747111
g.text: It seems I am the only one who remembers what is at stake here !

g.title: j1823586972
g.text: You're making assumptions, now. You don't know that. You've never met her, and you have no idea what she's been through. Or what she's had to endure.

g.title: j2109556813
g.text: And do you think that will make him love you more, if you do? Do you think that'll make him come back to you, if you're the one who stays loyal to him?

g.title: j2025010587
g.text: I - I cannot. I cannot continue. Forgive me. We will talk again of this tomorrow, I must gather my thoughts.

g.title: j3563415872
g.text: Boolean MarieWarning is now true.

g.title: j4094969604->Chat ends. Next chat will be MarieEntratiDay2.
j1937162989
g.text: Boolean MarieNoDate is now true.

g.title: j2710935490
g.text: Ta gueule !

g.title: j924576668
g.text: I... that is not what I meant. This is not a holy war, this is something entirely...

g.title: j4098688192
g.text: Oui ! Précisément. And I am certain everyone will come around in time. I am simply glad to have a friend in this matter with me.

g.title: j1238786434
g.text: Trust me, no you're not. Countless people have lost their lives to this. And I can rattle off a list of names of people who have had their lives ruined because of him. But no one's forgotten about the Indifference.

g.title: j3821279683
g.text: I am sure if I were to meet her, I would know about it before long ! Everyone here is so quick to tell me about all their suffering at his hands ! No wonder le Cardinal does not return. I would not spend a single moment here if I were him -

g.title: j3040676169
g.text: I do not think it would drive him away ! Do you think le Cardinal would return to this nest of vipères ?! Non ! I would not spend a single moment here if I were him -

g.title: j129422171
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j3178861260
g.text: And you needn't talk to me like I am a child.

g.title: j2945887645
g.text: Boolean MarieEntrati5h is now true.

g.title: j3638167583
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j1440965731
g.text: I must go.

g.title: j300343042
g.text: +40 Chemistry

g.title: j1716414340
g.text: Are you so certain ? Everyone here is so quick to tell me about their suffering at his hands ! But never what cause it was in service to !

g.title: j780992367
g.text: Where even Monsieur Loid, who claims to love him, cannot help but bemoan his cruelty at every opportunity !

g.title: j2049400718
g.text: Boolean MarieEntrati5f is now true.

g.title: j2945887645->Chat ends. Next chat will be MarieEntratiDay2.
j2171368046
g.text: Boolean MarieEntrati5a is now true.

g.title: j1196339321
g.text: +15 Chemistry

g.title: Chat ends.
g.text: Chat ends.

g.title: j3466336941
g.text: Le Cardinal is fighting a war ! And in war, some innocents must be hurt. It is sad, but it is fact !

g.title: j4178695248
g.text: No one understands le Cardinal. He is fighting a war ! And in war, some innocents will be hurt. It is sad, but it is fact !

g.title: j2049400718->Chat ends. Next chat will be MarieEntratiDay2.
j2171368046->Chat ends. Next chat will be MarieEntratiDay2.
j2104782928
g.text: Boolean MarieEntrati5d is now true.

g.title: j528953889
g.text: Roathe would be so proud of you.

g.title: j910315463
g.text: Marie. I'm sorry, this isn't some "holy war." You're very new to all this, and Entrati has you wrapped around his finger.

g.title: j1506968569
g.text: And... where in the doctrine of Sol does it say it's okay to hurt innocents in war?

g.title: j2104782928->Chat ends. Next chat will be MarieEntratiDay2.
j4131404618
g.text: Check boolean MarieWarning

g.title: j4249758133
g.text: Evaluate expressions

g.title: j3809253007
g.text: I told you not to speak down to me. I am done here. And we are done.

g.title: j4131404618->j3809253007
g.text: true

g.title: j3746052144
g.text: Do not to speak down to me ! I am no fool, I can see the cost of his actions. I simply do not see it outweigh the scales !

g.title: j4131404618->j3746052144
g.text: false

g.title: j899155486
g.text: And now you speak to me of faith ?! When it is useful to you ?! Non ! I think not ! I am done here. And we are done.

g.title: j4249758133->j899155486
g.text: DrifterFaithNoFear

g.title: j4249758133->j899155486
g.text: DrifterFaithNoMITW

g.title: j4249758133->j899155486

g.title: j1172567627
g.text: Ne t'avise pas de me parler de ce dont tu ne sais rien, toi... non. Non ! Non ! Nous en avons terminé !

g.text: Boolean MarieWarning is now false.

g.text: Boolean MarieWarning is now true.

g.text: Boolean MarieEntrati5b is now true.

g.title: j1508846227
g.text: Enough. I am done arguing in circles !
